name: Plan Load Test
summary: Design a capacity experiment with a representative workload, safety envelope, observability, and stop rules.
description: Plan a bounded load, stress, soak, or spike test from a representative workload model, service objectives, production safeguards, observability, and explicit abort criteria. Use before testing capacity or claiming performance at scale.
refuses: It does not run load against production, third-party systems, or shared environments without explicit scoped authorization.
It does not create unbounded traffic, uncontrolled cost, destructive test data, or a denial-of-service condition.
It does not claim capacity from averages, a single run, a nonrepresentative workload, or client-side metrics alone.
